assert d['schema_version'] == 6

assert len(d['training']['candidates']) == 4
for c in d['training']['candidates']:
    for k in ('balanced_mae','mae','rmse','macro_f1'):
        assert math.isfinite(float(c['validation'][k]))
for k in ('balanced_mae','mae','rmse','macro_f1'):
    assert math.isfinite(float(d['training']['winner_test'][k]))
print('TRAINING_RESULT_VALIDATION=PASS')
